body:
Implement the following Phase P0 correctness fixes and enhancements for adaptation to agy 1.1.11:
1. Model Slugs & Mapping: Replace display-name model strings in lib/agy.mjs MODELS, lib/pools.mjs TIER_CANDIDATES, and PROSECUTORS with stable slugs. Add Gemini 3.6 Flash to cheap/mid tiers. Make model slug checks case-insensitive and support simple aliases or mapping configurations.
2. Quota Pools Remodeling: Re-model lib/pools.mjs around the two metered quota pools (Gemini Models | Claude and GPT models) with per-family concurrency caps kept as a separate axis. Dynamic pool structures parsed from agy -p "/quota" on startup.
3. Five-Hour Rolling Limit: Poll agy -p "/quota" at run start and between waves; pause or reroute dispatch when a pool's remaining five-hour limit drops below configured floor. Surface limits in status and sidecar.
4. Multi-process Quota State File Locking: Add locking mechanisms to agb_pools_shared.json to prevent race conditions during concurrent booster runs.
5. Preflight model check: Add checks in agb doctor / run-preflight to diff the model tables against live agy models output.

Acceptance criteria:
1. Model mapping logic, TIER_CANDIDATES, and PROSECUTORS use stable slugs, are case-insensitive, and support configuration aliases.
2. Quota pools are remodeled to track 'Gemini Models' and 'Claude and GPT models' separately from concurrency semaphores.
3. The five-hour rolling limit is polled and checked, pausing runTicket inline if needed.
4. Concurrent writes to agb_pools_shared.json do not race (verified via test/concurrency).
5. Unit tests cover model mapping, quota checks, state file locking, and inline pause mechanics.
6. npm test passes cleanly.
title: feat: implement roadmap P0 correctness fixes and enhancements
